reviewer: Independent original-pixel, actual-reference and source reviewer

entries.recommendedTitle: Fear not; I am the first and the last
entries.alt: The risen Savior touches John's shoulder among seven golden lampstands.
entries.caption: John looks up as the risen Savior lays His hand upon him. In the vision's brightness, Christ speaks reassurance: He lives for evermore.
entries.findings: V3 compared with v2 and actual canonical Christ/apostle references. John repaired toward mapped third-from-left identity: narrower nose/face, dark shorter beard, no Peter-like gray full beard; mature expression preserves recognizable John. Christ white head hair and beard, chest-level gold sash, seven lampstands, calm reciprocal gaze and shoulder touch retained. Exposed palm and wrist show healed marks; contact hand/palm naturally obscured. Photographic natural faces and cloth, no grotesque vision effects.
conditions: This selected reassurance scene does not claim to reproduce every symbolic detail in Revelation1. John's precise age, coastline, lampstand design and postures are interpretation; maturity does not establish a numeric age.
Accept v3 only; retain earlier rejected versions. Technical review is not owner approval or browser verification.
